lines.zh: 低沉的吼声回荡在岩浆之中。
岩石碎裂，伴随着低沉的呼吸声。
缓缓移动，留下一串岩浆足迹。
火红的身躯在黑暗中显得格外醒目。
lines.en: Red body stands out in the dark.

lines.zh: 目光紧盯着玩家的一举一动。
从岩浆中升起，周身冒着热气。
步伐沉重，每一步都发出声响。
火舌在周围跳动，为它照明。
lines.en: Flames dance around, lighting the way.

lines.zh: 脚步沉重，每一步都充满力量。
目光闪烁，寻找着研究的线索。

lines.en: I carry books across the hut.

lines.zh: 静静地坐在火堆旁沉思。
lines.en: Sits quietly by the fire, thinking.

lines.zh: 环顾四周，警惕地观察着。
盯着手中的卷轴，似乎在阅读。
lines.en: Stares at the scroll in hand.

lines.zh: 悠闲地坐在岩石上，享受着寂静。
lines.en: Relaxes on a rock, enjoying the silence.

lines.zh: 静静地躺着，似乎在沉睡。
凝视着远方，似乎在回忆。
lines.en: Stares into the distance, seemingly remembering.

lines.zh: 静静地盯着手中的宝物。
lines.en: Stares at a treasure in hand.

lines.zh: 环视着周围，寻找着什么。
lines.en: Scans the surroundings, looking for something.
I keep the record of your studies.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，似乎在思考对策。
lines.en: Stares at the player, thinking of a strategy.

lines.zh: 突然注视玩家，似乎有所察觉。
lines.en: Suddenly stares at the player, noticing something.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁，似乎认出了玩家。
目光锐利，紧紧盯着玩家。
lines.en: Sharp eyes fixed on the player.

lines.zh: 目光中透出好奇，盯着玩家。
lines.en: Curious eyes fixed on the player.
Eyes scan the player, like lightning.
Do not tear the books; that is my research.

lines.zh: 你们的碰撞，伤害不了我
寻找我的伴侣，延续生命
我这里只有书和研究的钥匙。
lines.en: I have only books and the key to research here.

lines.zh: 寻找我的伴侣，完成使命
lines.en: Find my mate, fulfill the mission

lines.zh: 低沉地咕哝，声音如同熔岩中发出的声音。
lines.en: Muttering low, like the sound from lava.

lines.zh: 啃食一些残骸，发出满足的咕噜声。
lines.en: Chomps on some debris, making a contented grumbling noise.

lines.zh: 用灼热的视线盯着你，仿佛能穿透灵魂。
lines.en: Fixes its scorching gaze on you, as if it can see through souls.

lines.zh: 从熔岩中取出一串水晶，仔细研究。
lines.en: Pulls a string of crystals from the lava, examining it closely.

lines.zh: 用翅膀拍打着，似乎在整理自己的思绪。
lines.en: Beats its wings, as if organizing thoughts.

lines.zh: 盯着远处的火焰，发出深沉的思考声。
lines.en: Fixes its gaze on distant flames, making a deep, contemplative sound.

lines.zh: 在熔岩表面跳跃，发出轻微的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Hops across the lava, making a slight hissing sound.

lines.zh: 从熔岩中捡起一块岩石，轻柔地抚摸。
lines.en: Grasps a rock from the lava, gently caressing it.

lines.zh: 低声念诵古老的咒语，仿佛在祈求庇护。
lines.en: Whispers ancient spells, as if invoking protection.

lines.zh: 用尖锐的爪子轻轻拍打地面，似乎在寻找什么。
lines.en: Taps the ground gently with its sharp claws, as if seeking something.

lines.zh: 向你投来一道炙热的目光。
lines.en: Shoots a burning gaze at you.

lines.zh: 突然跳到你面前，准备攻击。
lines.en: Leaps in front of you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 伸出长长的舌头，向你舔去。
lines.en: Extends its long tongue, lapping at you.

lines.zh: 用它的触手抓住你，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Snatches at you with its tentacles, making a hissing sound.

lines.zh: 用爪子钩住你，将你拖向熔岩。
lines.en: Hooks you with its claws, dragging you toward the lava.

lines.zh: 用它的触须缠绕你，试图将你拉近。
lines.en: Wraps its tentacles around you, trying to pull you closer.

lines.zh: 你的气息带着新维度的尘。
lines.en: Your scent carries dust from another dimension.

lines.zh: 用翅膀扇动，向你施加压力。
lines.en: Flaps its wings, applying pressure on you.
What do you come to ask? Sit first.
The Nether's affairs are in my records.
I've added your name to the list.

lines.zh: 注视你，眼中闪烁着研究的欲望。
lines.en: Fixes its gaze on you, eyes flickering with curiosity.

lines.zh: 用它的火球瞄准你，准备发射。
lines.en: Aligns its fireball at you, ready to fire.

lines.zh: 用触手缠绕你，试图控制你。
lines.en: Wraps its tentacles around you, trying to control you.

lines.zh: 开始绘制你，记录你的一切。
lines.en: Begins to sketch you, documenting every detail.

lines.zh: 用它的触手轻轻触碰你，似乎在检查。
lines.en: Gently touches you with its tentacles, as if examining you.

lines.zh: 用翅膀扇动，试图驱散你。
lines.en: Flaps its wings, trying to disperse you.

lines.zh: 用爪子抓住你，试图将你困住。
lines.en: Grasps you with its claws, trying to trap you.

lines.zh: 用它的火球瞄准，准备释放。
lines.en: Aligns its fireball, ready to release.

lines.zh: 将你置于显微镜下，仔细观察。
lines.en: Places you under a microscope, examining you closely.

lines.zh: 用它的触须缠绕你，试图捕捉你。
lines.en: Wraps its tentacles around you, trying to capture you.
Don't thumb that book; it'll scatter.

lines.zh: 我要先看你带回来的东西。
lines.en: First, let me see what you brought back.
I haven't finished the margins of this page.
My memory is poor; my notes are not.

lines.zh: 我用利爪撕裂你的皮肉！
lines.en: Tear at thy flesh with my claws!

lines.zh: 我的研究进度，死了也不会丢。
lines.en: My research survives even if I fall.
Pages fall from the beams of my hut.
Leave thy skin marred by my claws!

lines.zh: 我把研究笔记砸在你头上。
lines.en: I swing my research notes at your head.

lines.zh: 我用利爪刺穿你的身体！
lines.en: Pierce thy body with my claws!

lines.zh: 尝尝我的利爪带来的疼痛！
lines.en: Taste the pain of my claws!

lines.zh: 用我的利爪划破你的皮肤！
lines.en: Slick thy skin with my claws!
Let me end thee with my claws!
I strike with a book's spine!
Back up, you're on my drafts!
I'll remember you. Don't come back.
You've finally arrived in the Nether!

lines.zh: 下界的门刚开，我就到了。
lines.en: The Nether gate just opened, and I am here.

lines.zh: 你是唯一能理解我的存在！
lines.en: Thou art the only one to understand me!

lines.zh: 欢迎来到编年家的小屋！

lines.en: You entered the Nether; then I moved in.

lines.zh: 小屋建在你的重生点旁。
lines.en: The hut rises by your spawn point.

lines.zh: 爆炸摧毁了我的图书馆...

lines.en: The void's cold wind froze me...
